Tool-capable text models are broad discovery hints, not proof of coding suitability. The 2026-10-09 update only rechecks selected configuration profiles, input limits and pricing scopes; the 2026-10-10 update only rechecks the Haiku 5.5 cost-first compaction profile. The broad release inventory remains the 2026-10-08 review, with vendor coverage still partial.
